admission.justification: The notice makes a change in the developer’s selected delivery setup visible even when the existing progress decision already authorizes it.

applicability: A coder switch under the existing review-progress decision.
conditions: The existing role owns the decision and gives the notice when the switch actually happens.
exclusions: A model switch grants no review allowance.
statement: The developer is told when the coder is switched, naming the model left and the model taken.
